propositions: Extract bridge orchestration into a runner-neutral Python core packaged in the wheel and expose it through Python library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run --profile), and MCP (bridge_run tool) without requiring repository-local scripts.

Preserve legacy MODE environment variable and reconcile result behavior (3/4/75 for direct callers; 0 for new provider runner) while standardizing public interfaces to use profile noun instead of MODE.

Support five profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) that map to existing rebar commands with environment validation, 3600-second timeout, pause-marker validation, and strict ticket-store delivery.
Validate wheel contents and prove availability from all three install shapes (pip, Homebrew wheel-backed, MCP Registry/uvx) without repository-local runner script or inline orchestration logic.

Replace inline GitHub orchestration and add native Jenkins/GitLab adapters that invoke the same installed CLI entrypoint; thin provider wrappers to only checkout, credentials, signing, artifacts, and exactly rebar bridge run.
Validate provider schemas against vendored immutable GitLab Draft-07 schema with provenance and lint embedded shell with pinned ShellCheck without accepting mismatched tooling.
